findings.pdf_says: UNLOCK file-name-1 [ RECORD | RECORDS ]  (one line: UNLOCK, then file-name-1, then a bracket stacking RECORD over RECORDS)
findings.why_it_matters: A reader or grammar author working from the transcription could take file-name-1 for an alternative stacked with UNLOCK, or misorder it relative to the optional RECORD/RECORDS bracket, and so derive the wrong UNLOCK syntax.
findings.detail: In the drawn figure, file-name-1 sits on a different row, in the same column as UNLOCK and below it, rather than after UNLOCK on the baseline. Read as a diagram, UNLOCK and file-name-1 look stacked in one column, and their order relative to the bracket is unclear. The printed format is UNLOCK file-name-1 followed by an optional bracket (no choice bars) holding RECORD/RECORDS. Suggested fix: put 'UNLOCK file-name-1' on the middle row before the bracket.
